name: Octave up
description: Double the base frequency of every connected pitch-tracked oscillator.

name: Octave down
description: Halve the frequency of the connected oscillator bank.

name: Fifth up
description: Transpose the bank up seven equal-tempered semitones.

name: Fine tune up
description: Shift every connected voice up ten cents.

name: Fine tune down
description: Shift every connected voice down ten cents.
